# satuuu99

> satuuu99 is a personal wellness studio at Manhagener Allee 45, 22926 Ahrensburg, Germany, near Hamburg.

Primary services: Japanese Head Spa, facial care including Aqua Facial, Sleep & Glow and Gua Sha, foot care and foot massage, and wellness or spa massage.
